interruption_caveat: Original server/client stopped after seven recorded successes. Whether DEV008 had started and its duration are unknown. Continuation restarted server and warmup/cache; no unknown duration is treated as zero.
cache_policy: Native exact-prompt prefill LRU uses 16384-token aggregate budget and retains at least one prompt. Smoke can warm development prefix; server restart resets cache. Timings are warm-service timings, not isolated cold calls.
